verdict.rationale: Event subscription is a fair question for a robotics middleware framework, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only DDS-based publish/subscribe over topics, services and actions between ROS nodes. There are no documented, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that an external programmatic consumer can receive, and native topic subscriptions are an adjacent mechanism, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
